body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2026-04-28 (Q4FY26 concall transcript): "none of them are sticky debtors ... close to about INR260 crores of funds, which was supposed to receive on the last week of March was received on the 1st and the 2nd of April ... we have already realized close to about INR600 crores to INR700 crores of debtors in the month of April itself" Metric: Trade receivables / debtor days. Target: normalise in FY27 (implied). Deadline: 2027-03-31 (implied). Specificity: vague; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: pending. Evidence: Interim check: trade receivables Sep-26 INR 1,223 cr (screener) vs 1,485 (Mar-26) and 701 (Mar-25). That is ~78 days on TTM revenue 5,731 cr, ~83 days on annualised H1, against 55 days in FY25. Even removing the INR 260 cr late receipt, Mar-26 is ~80 days. So the timing story explains only part of the rise. Not raised again by management in the Aug-26 or Oct-26 calls.
